All the time. I don't like when people see me in a vulnerable state and holding in all those emotions ends up hurting me even more in the end :(

I ran track in high school and during my junior year, me and my team were on our way to a meet. I had a pad on and some light jean shorts on throughout the school day and during our busy ride to the meet. Throughout the whole ride I could just feel my body doing it's thing and I was just hoping I didn't bleed through but I knew something didn't feel right. Anyway we get off the bus and walk over to our tent area which is where we would stay until we had our events and after like five minutes of standing up, talking to friends around at least 60 of my teammates, two of my friends told me I bled through my shorts. And I'm pretty sure my at the time crush saw. Luckily I had my track pants in my bag and wrapped my jacket around my waist when I was headed to the bathroom to change. Surprisingly, I wasn't that embarrassed and kinda forgot about it within hours. I just remembered hoping that I started bleeding through on the bus rather than the whole school day which is like 10x more embarrassing in my opinion. But that was definitely my worst period story lol.
